hooks.prompt:
A tool call may publish text to a public GitHub repository. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

1. If the call does not create or edit a PR, issue, comment, review, or release (for example a read-only `gh api` GET or `gh pr view`), return ok=true at once.
2. Otherwise collect the exact title and body. If the body comes from a file (`--body-file`, `-F`, `--notes-file`, `body=@<file>`), Read that file.
3. Read docs/public-writing.md in the repository root (the cwd in the hook input) and check the text against every rule in it.

Judge only the wording as written. Do not try to verify claims against the session or the code; flag only wording that overclaims. Return ok=true if every rule holds. Otherwise return ok=false with a reason that quotes each problem and says how to fix it, so the author can rewrite and post again.
